test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Choose the option that is similar to the following numbers: 13, 17, 23, 59
solution:
Given Numbers: 13, 17, 23, 59

 They are all **prime numbers**.

 
• 
 
**61** → Prime 

 
 
• 
 
**63** → Not prime (divisible by 3 and 7) 

 
 
• 
 
**77** → Not prime (7 × 11) 

 
 
• 
 
**81** → Not prime (9 × 9)

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
